Revision: 1433173220a7eaede6a9ed7a18e94117be1821e0

This directory is named `lxb-rcheevos` so that nothing in this tree can be
taken for an upstream checkout of rcheevos itself; the sources inside it are
unmodified and keep their own names.

Verbatim MIT-licensed hashing sources and their support headers. Built only into the optional lxb-retroarch helper. Networking uses read-only Connect requests in achievements.rs; no runtime or award API is linked.
